decisive_items: atypical lymphocytes with focal areas of epidermotropism
Positive for CD2, CD3, CD4, and CD45RO
clonal amplification product for the γ-chain of the T-cell receptor
response.rationale: The chronic pruritic patches, atypical CD4-positive lymphocytes with epidermotropism, and clonal TCR rearrangement are characteristic of mycosis fungoides, a specific cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. R3 is the broader category and less specific.

rejected.why: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is a broader category; the clinical and histopathologic features specifically support mycosis fungoides.
